overview: ComVo proposes a fully complex-valued neural vocoder for iSTFT-based waveform generation, featuring complex-domain adversarial training with a CVNN generator and complex multi-resolution discriminator, a phase quantization inductive bias, and a block-matrix computation scheme for efficient training.

modules.name: Complex-Valued Neural Network Primitives
modules.description: Implementation of fundamental CVNN building blocks including complex-valued Conv1d, Conv2d, Linear layers, complex LayerNorm, and split-type complex activation functions (split GELU, complex LeakyReLU), all operating natively on complex-valued tensors with Wirtinger-calculus-compatible gradient computation.

modules.name: Block-Matrix Computation Engine
modules.description: Custom autograd functions that reformulate complex-valued operations as real-valued block-matrix multiplications, fusing four separate real multiplications into a single structured matrix operation for both forward and backward passes, reducing backward graph node count and improving GPU parallelism.

modules.name: Phase Quantization Layer
modules.description: Nonlinear transformation layer that discretizes phase angles of complex features into a fixed set of quantization levels using a rounding operation, with a straight-through estimator (STE) applied during backpropagation to preserve gradient flow, serving as an inductive bias for structured phase learning.

modules.name: Complex ConvNeXt Block
modules.description: The core residual building block of the generator, implementing a complex-domain adaptation of the ConvNeXt architecture with complex depthwise convolution, complex LayerNorm, complex pointwise convolutions, and split GELU activation, all operating in the complex field.

modules.name: ComVo Generator
modules.description: Full generator architecture adapted from Vocos, comprising an initial complex Conv1d, phase quantization layer, a stack of complex ConvNeXt blocks, and a complex iSTFT synthesis head that directly outputs a complex spectrogram for frame-level waveform reconstruction without learned upsampling.

modules.name: Complex Multi-Resolution Discriminator (cMRD)
modules.description: Spectrogram-level discriminator operating directly on complex-valued STFT inputs using complex convolutions and activations, composed of multiple sub-discriminators each processing at a different STFT resolution (varying FFT/hop/window sizes), outputting complex-valued decisions whose real and imaginary parts are used separately in the adversarial loss.

modules.name: Multi-Period Discriminator (MPD)
modules.description: Waveform-level real-valued discriminator consisting of multiple sub-discriminators, each reshaping 1D waveform segments into 2D representations over different periods to expose distinct periodic patterns, using stacked 2D convolutions with LeakyReLU activations and outputting real-valued scalar scores.

modules.name: Complex-Domain Adversarial Training Objectives
modules.description: Complete set of loss functions including component-wise hinge adversarial losses for cMRD (applied separately to real and imaginary discriminator outputs), hinge adversarial loss for MPD, L1 Mel-spectrogram reconstruction loss, and feature matching losses for both discriminators (with separate real/imaginary component matching for cMRD), combined with configurable weighting coefficients.

modules.name: Data Processing Pipeline
modules.description: Audio preprocessing including resampling, STFT/iSTFT computation with configurable parameters (FFT size, hop length, window type), Mel-spectrogram extraction with specified bin count and frequency range, audio segment extraction for training, and all necessary feature engineering for the iSTFT-based synthesis workflow.

modules.name: Dataset Construction and Data Loading
modules.description: Custom Dataset class for LibriTTS and MUSDB18-HQ corpora handling audio loading, fixed-length segment sampling, Mel-spectrogram and complex spectrogram pair generation, with DataLoader configuration including batch collation, shuffling, and multi-worker prefetching for efficient GPU utilization.

modules.name: Training Loop and Optimization Control
modules.description: Main training orchestration managing alternating generator-discriminator updates with AdamW optimizer, cosine learning rate scheduling, gradient handling for complex-valued parameters via Wirtinger calculus, single-GPU execution, and epoch/step-based training progression for the full adversarial training procedure.

modules.name: Objective Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Implementation and integration of all objective metrics: UTMOS for predicted naturalness, multi-resolution STFT (MR-STFT) error for spectral distortion, wideband PESQ for perceptual quality, periodicity RMSE for periodic artifact quantification, and voiced/unvoiced F1 score for voicing classification accuracy.

modules.name: Subjective Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Framework for conducting MOS, SMOS, and CMOS listening tests including sample generation, randomized presentation, attention-check filtering with fake samples, and score aggregation with confidence interval computation across multiple evaluators.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Controlled experimental setup for systematic ablations including: real-valued vs. complex-valued generator/discriminator combinations (GRDR, GCDR, GRDC, GCDC), individual discriminator component evaluation (MPD-only, MRD-only, cMRD-only), phase quantization level sensitivity analysis, and parameter scaling comparisons to isolate complex-domain modeling benefits from memory/capacity effects.

modules.name: Discriminator Attention Visualization
modules.description: Grad-CAM implementation for complex-valued discriminators to generate class activation maps over complex spectrograms, enabling qualitative comparison of spectral attention patterns across real-valued and complex-valued discriminator configurations at multiple STFT resolutions.

modules.name: Computational Efficiency Analysis
modules.description: Profiling tools for measuring training time, inference throughput (xRT), GPU memory consumption, parameter counts, backward computation graph complexity (node count comparison), and runtime scaling with utterance duration across native PyTorch, Gauss-trick, and block-matrix implementations.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Infrastructure
modules.description: YAML-based configuration management for all hyperparameters (STFT settings, model dimensions, loss weights, optimizer settings), experiment tracking with logging, model checkpoint save/load, numerical consistency verification between block-matrix and native implementations, and automated result aggregation into tables and charts.
